summary: S.I.R. is an implemented F# tactical-skirmish game with an authoritative server, shared deterministic simulation, WebAssembly control modules, browser tooling and replay. It is externally owned at EHotwagner/S.I.R.; the final period is part of the repository and Pages path. The README assigns canonical game design, architecture and roadmap documentation to the published Pages site, generated from docs/, and product planning to the EHotwagner S.I.R. project rather than the FS-GG organization backlog. Producer-owned dependencies retain their own owners. Actual source includes Domain, Simulation, Wasm, Match, Protocol, Server, Client and Replay projects, not only design documents. Its declared CI/conformance and browser gates and implemented-roadmap claims require their own observed evidence; this read-only source audit establishes neither current deployment nor a fresh test pass.
title: S.I.R. product, documentation and planning ownership
